summary.text: Sharon Carson is a Republican state senator from New Hampshire who has represented District 14 since 2008 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
Ballotpedia's 2026 election page lists her as Senate President.

paragraphs.text: Carson earned an A.S. from Mount Wachussett Community College in 1986 and a B.A., M.A. and A.B.D. from the University of New Hampshire in 1996, 1998 and 2001, respectively.
Her professional experience includes serving on the adjunct faculty at Nashua Community College and working as a teaching assistant for the University of New Hampshire from 1999 to 2002.
Carson was a sergeant first class in the United States Army Reserve, serving as a medical technologist at the 323rd Medical Lab from 1978 to 1996.
Before holding elected office, Carson served as a delegate at the New Hampshire State Convention from 1998 to 2000.
In the 2025-2026 session she serves on the Capital Budget, Education Finance, Senate Finance and Rules and Enrolled Bills committees, and is vice chair of the last of these.
